questions.question: Why did Shishak king of Egypt come up against Jerusalem?
options: By chance, while merely passing through the land
Because Rehoboam and Judah forsook God's law
To take revenge for an old and bitter insult
To seize the gold stored in the temple treasury
questions.answer: Because Rehoboam and Judah forsook God's law

questions.question: What did Rehoboam and the princes do when the prophet warned them?
Shishak took away the treasures of the temple and the king's house.
Because they humbled themselves, the LORD's wrath turned and he granted them some _____.
Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace the _____ shields Shishak took.
